messages.content: Texas curveballs: the Dallas fair sent a new load-in map, Waco says hot breakfast starts too late for my Wednesday departure, and American nudged the Austin connection by a little bit. Can you sanity-check the final ground plan?

Yes. I would keep the Dallas garage plan rather than trying to improvise surface parking. The new map mainly changes how you enter and unload: aim for the marked garage entrance, keep the QR/parking confirmation handy, and arrive closer to 3:20 so you have time to get the boxes upstairs before the fair starts.
The map says SUVs should use the north entrance and no unloading at the curb. We have the garage reservation already. Should I change anything?

No change to the reservation. Add a note in the trip folder: north garage entrance, fair load-in level, no curb unload. Confirm the garage clearance one more time against the rental category, and print or screenshot the parking pass in case cell service is messy.
For Waco, I need to leave about 6:10 Wednesday. Their hot breakfast is now 7:00.

Treat the hotel breakfast as unavailable that morning. Best backup: buy coffee, yogurt, fruit, and a protein bar Tuesday night after the Waco fair, then use the room fridge. If the lobby has any grab-and-go items early, consider that a bonus, not the plan.
American moved the Phoenix connection to 66 minutes. Still okay?

Still workable, but I would not tighten the Austin airport timing. Keep the Round Rock departure conservative, return the SUV around 1:30, and go straight through security for the 3:05 flight. In Phoenix, skip a sit-down meal and stay near the next gate.
Can you give me the final short checklist for materials and receipts?

Trip-folder checklist: 1) Dallas garage pass, load-in map, and north-entrance note. 2) Keep boxes covered in the SUV; do not leave materials visible overnight. Bring the banner tube and any high-value packets into each hotel. 3) Recount boxes after each fair/school visit. 4) Waco breakfast backup bought Tuesday night. 5) Austin: fuel before return if required, rental return by 1:30, 66-minute Phoenix connection. 6) Save airfare receipt, hotel folios, rental receipt, one-way fee, fuel, tolls, Dallas parking, and any materials shipping or baggage receipts.

messages.content: Switching from admissions travel to family logistics: my younger one has a club volleyball tournament in Mesa the last weekend of October. Early Saturday pool play is possible, Sunday brackets could run into the afternoon, and the team hotel block has fuzzy cancellation terms. Can you compare flying versus driving for three of us?
I can. Two details affect the recommendation: which Mesa venue, and what is the earliest you can leave Salt Lake on Friday after school and work?

Arizona Athletic Grounds in east Mesa. Realistically we can leave our house at 3:30 Friday. If we drive, it would be after school too. First match time is not posted yet, but the coach warned us to plan for early.

With a 3:30 Friday start, flying is much kinder to Saturday. Driving is roughly 10.5 to 11.5 hours before longer stops, so you would be arriving very late or splitting the drive and losing Friday night anyway. A late-afternoon SLC-PHX flight gets you to a rental car and east Mesa hotel around dinner or shortly after.
What about just sending one parent with her? I am trying not to make this a giant production.

That is the lowest-cost flight version, but it has trade-offs: one parent handles the gear, meals, possible bracket changes, and any late-night return alone. For an early Saturday start, I would rank it: fly all three if fares are reasonable, fly one parent plus athlete if cost is the deciding factor, drive only if flights are unusually high or you can leave much earlier.
The team block says it is about 7 minutes from the venue, $179, but I do not see cancellation terms or breakfast. What other areas should I consider?

Shortlist the areas this way: East Mesa/Gateway area is closest to the venue and easiest for warmups, but dining can be more limited. Gilbert/SanTan Village adds about 15 to 20 minutes and gives better dinner choices. Mesa Riverview/Tempe is better for airport access and food, but it is too far for an early first serve.
We need one room with two queens, parking, and breakfast if possible. I do not want to be hunting for food before a 7 a.m. warmup.

Then I would hold a refundable two-queen backup near East Mesa or Gilbert with breakfast and free parking, even if it is a few minutes farther than the team block. The team hotel is only worth holding if they confirm: cancellable deadline, two queens guaranteed, breakfast status, parking cost, and no resort or event fee.
Can you put the family schedule impact in a quick table?

Plan | Friday impact | Saturday risk | Notes. Fly all three | Leave home about 3:30, catch late-afternoon/early-evening flight, hotel by evening | Low | Best rest, highest cost. Drive all three | Arrive around 2 a.m. or later with stops | High | Cheapest transport, worst for early play. One parent flies with athlete | Similar timing to flying all three | Low to medium | Cheaper, but more solo logistics.
Should I book the team block now while I wait on the game schedule?

Only if you can get the cancellation terms in writing today. Otherwise, hold the refundable backup first. For this weekend I would plan on flying Friday, staying two nights in a two-queen room near East Mesa or Gilbert, using the hotel breakfast as the morning plan, and choosing a Sunday return late enough to survive a bracket run. We can tighten flights once the first match and last possible final are posted.

messages.content: Mesa update: first match is 8:00 Saturday, and the latest Sunday final could start around 4:30 with awards after. The team block now only has nonrefundable rooms. A refundable hotel about 12 minutes farther has two queens, breakfast, and free parking. Help me choose.

Given the 8:00 Saturday start, I would fly rather than drive. I would also skip the nonrefundable team block. The refundable hotel costs a little more in drive time, but it protects you if the bracket shifts or anyone gets sick, and breakfast plus free parking offsets part of the rate difference.
The refundable one is $164, cancelable until Thursday, breakfast starts at 6:00, two queens confirmed. The team block is $149, nonrefundable, and breakfast is not included.

That makes the refundable hotel the better value. For $15 more before taxes, you get cancellation flexibility, confirmed bedding, breakfast, and parking. For Saturday, plan to be downstairs at 6:05, eat quickly or grab items to go, leave by about 6:35, and arrive with cushion for a 7:15ish warmup.
Flights are close. Friday options: 4:25, 5:15, or 6:05 out of Salt Lake. Sunday return options are 7:30 or 9:10. Monday morning is available but ugly for school and work.

I would avoid Monday. For Friday, the 5:15 is the safest balance if school pickup makes 4:25 rushed; the 6:05 is fine but pushes dinner and hotel arrival later. For Sunday, choose 9:10. A 7:30 return is too tight if a 4:30 final runs long, awards happen, and you still need to reach PHX, return the car, and clear security.
The 9:10 return costs about $45 more per person than the 7:30. Still worth it?

For this schedule, yes. The extra $135 buys a real buffer against missing the flight. Missing the 7:30 would likely cost more than that and turn into either a very late rebooking or Monday travel anyway.
Do we need a rental car if the hotel mentions a shuttle?

Yes, I would rent a car. Tournament shuttles are rarely flexible enough for warmups, food runs, and bracket changes. A midsize car should work unless you are carrying extra team gear; free hotel parking makes that easy.
Okay. Book the refundable hotel, Friday 5:15, Sunday 9:10, and a car. Give me the notes for the confirmation email to my spouse.

Confirmation notes: Fly SLC-PHX Friday on the 5:15 option after school/work; return Sunday on the 9:10 option to protect a possible late final and awards. Book the refundable two-queen hotel 12 minutes farther from the venue: $164, cancelable until Thursday, breakfast from 6:00, free parking. Skip the nonrefundable team block because it lacks breakfast and flexibility. Rent a midsize car for airport, venue, and food runs. Saturday plan: breakfast at 6:05, leave hotel 6:35, warmup buffer for the 8:00 match. Sunday: keep bags in the car, choose an easy early dinner near the venue or airport after brackets, and leave for PHX as soon as awards finish. Save flight, hotel, rental, parking, and any tournament-fee receipts.
